notablePrerequisites:
Blinkmoth Nexus does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional land.
description:
Activate Blinkmoth Nexus' second ability by paying {1}, causing it to become a 1/1 Blinkmoth artifact creature in addition to its other types.
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exchange of Words enters the battlefield, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of Ley Weaver and Blinkmoth Nexus.
Activate Blinkmoth Nexus by tapping it, untapping itself and any other land you control.
Repeat step 4.
